text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, have we arrived? Thank you for 
guiding me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...That said, aside from the Three 
Goddesses statue, I don't really see 
anything else around here...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Could it be you wanted to introduce me to 
the Three Goddesses...?
